node.title: Rank-eleven rank-two residual base/plane dichotomy
node.closure: the shortened rank-two bucket either shortens again on an active residual base or emits one heavy rank-four residual plane
node.statement: In the shortened KoalaBear rank-eleven rank-two-triple bucket, the residual base H has dimension three and every first-owned residual class has at least 37733 common roots. If H has at least 10001 common zero coordinates, its locator reversibly shortens the complete 388650911452-slope bucket. Otherwise every class is a plane; separating at most 10000 zero columns leaves at least 27733 coordinates in a disjoint projective clone per plane, so at most 39 planes occur. One plane has mass at least 9965407986, exceeding the rank-three cap 3977322801 and forcing correction rank exactly four. Neither output is paid here.
